q: 1. The top and sides of a clamp (pazawah) is plastered with mud and cow dung to prevent.....
explain: Plastering the exterior of the clamp acts as insulation to retain the internal heat required for proper burning.

q: 2. The recent material used in cladding multi storeyed commercial buildings in Kathmandu
explain: Aluminium Composite Panels (ACP) are popular for modern commercial facades due to their lightweight and aesthetic appeal.
